# P35.44 — Dossier contribution export

**Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/323_P35.44__dossier-contribution-export.md`
(manifest row **323**, Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11B; ticket catalog
`R11-K13-DSRC-01`). Invoked `live_verification=false` — a read view,
exporter code, emitted artifacts and tests only; **no production
mutation, no spine write, no source flip, no gate tick, no merge to
main, no outside contact**. Requirement stamps: **SIG-TRANSP-008**
(the dossier↔source contribution numbers this artifact feeds) +
**SIG-TRANSP-040** (`Also:` — the `contributions[]` mirror on
`transparency/sources.json`, one computation serving both surfaces).
Served/cited: **SIG-UI-044** (the dossier-scope `provenance_summary`
fields, verbatim, `human_review_status: "unreviewed"`), **SIG-UI-048**
(honest absence tokens — `run_level_only`, `not_recorded`,
`not_evaluable`, `not_typed`, never silent zeros), **SIG-ENG-021**
(a re-sighting gap is disclosed, never a silent zero), **K4
`placement@1`** (the versioned ruleset named in `rules_applied`; this
row reads placement output, never re-derives it), **J3 T-2** (the
explicit-column `sig_export`-only view pattern), **D-K5-4** (PKG-10's
per-dossier "How we know this" absorbed here — recorded answered at
T3). K5 §8's draft `SIG-DSRC-*` ids are design refs pending PLAN-11C
numbering. **Base:** `r11/P35.43-watch-producer-v1` · **Gate:** none.

## The problem

A dossier page could say *which* sources contribute but never *how
much*, *when first/last seen*, or *whether the latest complete run
still asserts them*; a source page could not say which dossiers it
contributes to. The evidence existed (claim↔capture bindings,
`ingest_run_completion` statuses, `placement@1` chains) but no read
assembled it — and any two-sided answer computed twice would fork.

## What landed

- **`db/deploy|revert|verify/claim_sightings.sql` + `db/sqitch.plan`**
  — the explicit-column edge-list view `v_claim_sightings`: the
  claim's identity/gate columns beside each establishing binding's
  capture, `binding_status`, `bound_at`, artifact, sighting source,
  run and retrieval instant. `role = 'establishes'` only;
  `GRANT SELECT TO sig_export` only; locators, excerpts, digests, OCFL
  ids and URLs are structurally absent. The verify script checks the
  columns, the grant boundary, and probes two establishing sightings
  + a `contradicts` exclusion.
- **`policy.transparency.CLAIM_SIGHTING_VIEW_COLUMNS`** + the closure
  test — deploy SQL, allow-list, verify SELECT, `EXPORT_QUERIES`,
  and the accumulator's positional `CLAIM_SIGHTINGS_COLUMNS` are
  asserted identical; never-exported names fail outside comments.
- **`exports/dossier_sources.py`** (new) —
  `DOSSIER_SOURCES_QUERIES["claim_sightings"]` runs the K5 §3.1
  group-by over the view under the shared publishable-claim /
  effective-rights / artifact / capture-seal gates plus the belief
  bound on `bound_at`. Contribution attribution is by
  `claim_source.source_id` (the spine's own "who asserted this" pick —
  the literal `ea.source_id` grouping would fork `contributions[]`
  from J3's `published_claims`; decision recorded in the run ledger).
  One accumulation then produces both surfaces:

  - per (dossier, source): records, located/placed splits, claims,
    claims-by-predicate, records by entity type + technology
    (`not_typed` named), placement basis/check counts, first/last
    seen + first/last run, `latest ok run` +
    `not_reasserted_in_latest_complete_run` (partial/quota/failed
    runs never win), intra-source coordinate conflicts, contradiction
    refs, monthly + per-run series;
  - ancestor roll-up: a record counts in every placement-chain
    ancestor (place → county → admin-1 → country, K4 §5.3) *and* its
    declared bucket, with the `declared_here_located_elsewhere` /
    `located_here_declared_elsewhere` disagreement legs counted on
    both sides;
  - `sig.dossier-sources/1` documents at
    `web/dossier_sources/<slug>.json` — release, jurisdiction
    (chain + boundary vintage), named definitions, totals, the
    SIG-UI-044 `provenance_summary`, figures carrying `by_source` +
    `sum_rule` (`distinct` disclosed the moment a record sits under
    two sources), `sources[]`, `cross_source.colocated_pairs`
    `not_evaluable` until DSRC-04, `downloads[]` empty pending
    DSRC-03;
  - `<slug>.runs.jsonl.gz` at country/admin-1 — one
    `sig.dossier-source-run/1` row per (source, run), gzip
    deterministic (mtime 0), registered as the `dossier_source_runs`
    registry resource; county/place dossiers carry the monthly
    `series` and link the source run log instead;
  - `contributions_by_source` — the source-side mirror consumed by
    `transparency/sources.json`; under `run_level_only` the mirror's
    `last_seen_at` names the same `not_recorded` the dossier row
    shows.
- **`exports/transparency.py`** — `emit_transparency_artifacts`
  accepts the shared map; full source rows gain `contributions[]`
  (a declared spec — `assert_documented` stays fail-closed), gated
  rows carry `[]` (S-11 discloses no contribution).
- **`exports/spine_export.py`** — splices the query into
  `EXPORT_QUERIES`, substitutes `{SIGHTING_BOUND}` in
  `fetch_export_raw`, computes the plan once before the transparency
  emit, and lands the artifacts in the manifest (schema ids, licences,
  compartments, `application/gzip` media type).
- **`exports/placement.py`** — read-only `jurisdiction_row` +
  `ancestor_chain` accessors over the verified pack — the artifact's
  name/level/vintage/chain metadata without re-deriving placement.

## §3.3 `run_level_only`

When every claim a source holds carries exactly one establishing link
*and* the source has more than one completed (`ok`) run, the export
cannot separate "not re-sighted" from "re-sightings not recorded":
the row emits `sightings: "run_level_only"`,
`last_seen: {not_recorded: <reason>}` and
`not_reasserted_in_latest_complete_run: {not_evaluable: <reason>}`
with the reason printed — first-seen stays a recorded fact.
`D-P30.2a-2` is DONE since P31.7, so post-fix sources carry real
re-sightings; the check is per-source for pre-fix claims.

## Tests (T1–T14)

- `tests/unit/test_claim_sightings_view_columns.py` — 12 tests: view
  column closure, grant boundary (`sig_export` only, `sig_read_public`
  absent), never-exported names, revert, plan order, verify SELECT,
  the query's gate tokens + positional column contract.
- `tests/exports/test_dossier_sources.py` — 12 fixture tests: Σ
  invariants + figure `by_source` reconciliation (T3), ancestor
  roll-up (T4), first/last seen + `ok`-only latest run +
  not-reasserted counts (T5), `run_level_only` incl. the single-run
  non-trigger (T6), dossier↔source mirror symmetry (T7), artifact
  shape + honest absences (T8), the multi-source `distinct` flip
  (T9), runs-file scope + deterministic gzip (T10),
  `contributions[]` on full rows + `[]` on gated rows (T11), sparse
  dossier valid emit (T14).
- `tests/db/test_claim_sightings.py` — 3 tests on the testcontainer
  spine (the whole sqitch plan deploys + verifies): allow-listed
  columns, `sig_export` selects / `sig_read_public` denied, seeded
  two-run sightings group to first/last seen + runs + links +
  `has_actual_capture`, `contradicts` never a sighting, and the
  aggregate executes through the real gate substitution.
